Resolves #44

DateSelector can navigate with the arrow keys without committing a date: configure `selectionModel: {selectOnNavigate: false}`, then Enter selects the highlighted destination. The default remains immediate selection. The navigation outline stays distinct from the selected day, including month/year transitions and queued arrows, and an intervening focus change is respected.

Evidence: L3 (real Chromium/App Worker component journeys and inspected navigation styling) plus L1 unit controls. No native OS focus-placement claim.

## AC Evidence

No structured ACs on #44. The original optional navigation/Enter behavior and the [implementation intake](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/44#implementation-intake--euclid-2026-11-05) are covered by `unit/selection/DateSelectorModel.spec.mjs` and `component/component/DateSelector.spec.mjs`. Existing default month navigation, per-window focus restoration and Picker Enter controls remain green.

## Deltas from ticket

- Navigation policy and the uncommitted cursor belong to `DateSelectorModel`; the existing DateSelector owns displayed-month rendering and settled focus. Committed `value` and selection remain separate from the preview. `selectOnNavigate` defaults to true and serializes with the existing model options.
- The null date-field consumer exposed an existing `hidePickerOnSelect` mismatch on both pointer and Enter: it tried to remove a floating picker from the field's VDOM. It now calls the existing `Picker.hidePicker()` owner. Arrows keep the field empty and picker open; either selection gesture commits and dismisses it, including Enter without arrows.
- A UTC+14 probe exposed the existing UTC-noon/local-calendar mismatch. DateSelector now parses its date-only values at local noon, shared by display, cursor, limits and transition settlement. The separate date-field submission conversion is unchanged. The navigation spec now runs in both timezone jobs.
- Change class: capability (`feat`). `agent-preflight` is not hosted in Engine; the shared baseline jobs carry its applicable checks.

## Test Evidence

Red first: the opt-out unit expected January 15 to remain committed after Right, but received January 16; the two existing default navigation tests passed.

Real-browser component run: 14 passed (9.7s). It checks repeated wrapping, distinct rendered outline versus filled selection, queued animated year crossing, external focus, pointer/programmatic replacement and three null date-field commit paths. Small reads use the existing App Worker RPC fixture; this is component evidence, not a Neural Link or installed-build receipt. The consumer close checks were red with both pointer and Enter before the floating-picker owner repair. The navigation screenshot was inspected locally. Four browser arms cover UTC+14 and UTC−11; their UTC-instant reads confirm that the real App Worker uses each intended timezone.

Development themes built successfully. Current full units pass 5,835 with 2 skipped; focused units pass 14/14 and the timezone tier passes 19/19 in each of UTC+14 and UTC−11. A diagnostic JSON-output setting interfered with two tests' nested CLI collection; the normal invocation without that setting passes. Syntax and staged checks pass.

### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:** Issue #44 (`@tobiu` original specification + Grace 2026-10-09 triage + Ada 2026-11-05 premise read + Euclid 2026-11-05 intake and Contract Ledger), changed-file list, current `dev` source of `src/selection/DateSelectorModel.mjs`, `src/component/DateSelector.mjs`, `src/form/field/Date.mjs`, and `resources/scss/src/component/DateSelector.scss`, plus a 3-call Memory Core prior-art sweep (`query_raw_memories` + `query_summaries`).
*   **Expected Solution Shape:** `DateSelectorModel` should own `selectOnNavigate: true` (default) and an uncommitted navigation cursor (`navigationId` / `navigationCls: 'neo-navigated'`), registering `Enter` in `register()` and removing it in `unregister()`. When `selectOnNavigate: false`, arrow keys advance `navigationId` and update the displayed month/year and focus via `DateSelector` without mutating `DateSelector.value`, while `Enter` commits the navigated date. It must not hardcode UTC-noon parsing (`T12:00:00.000Z` shifts calendar dates in `UTC+14`) or inline VDOM child removal on `form.field.Date` (`hidePicker()` owns floating dismissal).
*   **Patch Verdict:** **Matches and improves on expected shape.** In addition to separating `navigationId` from `items`, `createDayViewContent` fixes `valueDay = valueDate.getDate()` (instead of `currentDate.getDate()`) so `neo-selected` stays anchored to the committed date when browsing another day in the same month, `dateFromValue` constructs dates at local noon (`new Date(year, month - 1, day, 12)`), and `form.field.Date#onDatePickerChange` delegates dismissal to `me.hidePicker()`.
*   **Premise Coherence:** Coheres with verify-before-assert and friction→gold: the `UTC+14` and `hidePickerOnSelect` probes surfaced two real shared defects along the consumer path and fixed them at their owning methods with regression coverage.
